title: Chinese People Can't Write Chinese
synopsis: Having a hard time memorizing all those Chinese characters? Don’t feel bad. In this lesson we see a survey which shows that even Chinese people have a hard time remembering them.

fullText.simplified:
中国人不会写汉字

    先做个小测试，你会写数字“0-10”的大写吗？
    今天我去银行交费，工作人员让我填一张表格。表格上有一项是要填交费金额的数字大写。我想了好久，也没有想起来，最后只能让工作人员帮写。这让我感到十分羞愧，作为一个大学毕业出来的中国人，我竟然连简单的大写数字都不会写了。
    回家后，我查找了一下原因。真是不查不知道，一查吓一跳。据调查，中国有83%的人和我一样，表示自己有提笔忘字的经历。同时，大多数人表示在平时的工作和生活中手写的机会不多。是的，随着科技的进步，现在写字用得更多的是手机和电脑。这让许多人，特别是年轻人写字的能力变得越来越差了。
    那么你呢？“0-10”的大写分别是“零、壹、贰、叁、肆、伍、陆、柒、捌、玖、拾”，你写对了吗？
fullText.traditional:
中國人不會寫漢字

    先做個小測試，你會寫數字“0-10”的大寫嗎？
    今天我去銀行交費，工作人員讓我填一張表格。表格上有一項是要填交費金額的數字大寫。我想了好久，也沒有想起來，最後只能讓工作人員幫寫。這讓我感到十分羞愧，作為一個大學畢業出來的中國人，我竟然連簡單的大寫數字都不會寫了。
    回家後，我查找了一下原因。真是不查不知道，一查嚇一跳。據調查，中國有83%的人和我一樣，表示自己有提筆忘字的經歷。同時，大多數人表示在平時的工作和生活中手寫的機會不多。是的，隨著科技的進步，現在寫字用得更多的是手機和電腦。這讓許多人，特別是年輕人寫字的能力變得越來越差了。
    那麼你呢？“0-10”的大寫分別是“零、壹、貳、叄、肆、伍、陸、柒、捌、玖、拾”，你寫對了嗎？

raw.synopsis: Having a hard time memorizing all those Chinese characters? Don’t feel bad. In this lesson we see a survey which shows that even Chinese people have a hard time remembering them.
sentence_translations: Chinese people can't write Chinese characters
Let's start with a small quiz: can you write the the capital Chinese characters for the numbers 0-10?
When I went to the bank today to pay a fee, the staff member asked me to fill out a form.
The form had an item where you had to fill in the fee amount using capital characters.
I thought for a long while, but still couldn't recall them, and in the end I had to have the staff member help me write it.
This made me feel very embarrassed.
A Chinese college graduate like myself could not even write simple capital numeric characters.
After returning home, I tried to look up the reason for this.
If I had not looked it up I would have never known, but what I found startled me.
According to a survey, 83% of people in China, express that they, like me, have experienced forgetting characters when writing.
At the same time, the majority say that they have few opportunities to write by hand in their work and everyday life.
That's right, following technological progress, most writing today is done using a mobile phone or computer.
This causes a lot of people's, and especially young people's, writing skills to become more and more lacking.
The capital characters for 0-10 are, in order: 零, 壹, 贰, 叁, 肆, 伍, 陆, 柒, 捌, 玖, 拾. Did you get them right?
